changelog: The trust tier arrives in the bundle: audits, watches, settlement attestations and reconciliations, Bitcoin anchors, the free preflight battery, and the signed corpus with its per-subject query. The Tab (scvd-tab) is listed as a second MCP server, now on npm. And the delivery ordering is corrected: the store delivers first and settles after as of 2026-08-10; the published bundle said the opposite.
